# Place Content

::: info 实现进度 55% · 进行中
Playground 已 `@source` 文档 markdown，这些类名可在本页示例里跑。未写入 `helpers.css`；SDK 里 schema 动态 class 仍依赖源码扫描。`m:` / `pc:` 只接到间距和宽高。
:::

同时设 `align-content` 与 `justify-content`。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: tpl
    className: grid h-24 place-content-center bg-muted rounded-md
    tpl: '<span class="bg-card p-sm rounded-md">居中</span>'
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `place-content-center` | `place-content: center` |
| `place-content-start` | `place-content: start` |
| `place-content-end` | `place-content: end` |
| `place-content-between` | `place-content: space-between` |
| `place-content-stretch` | `place-content: stretch` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 目前只接到间距和宽高辅助类。其它类请用 Tailwind 断点（`max-md:` / `md:`）。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
